results.title: Importing Auto Parts into US: 2026 Section 232 Guide
results.content:
Most auto parts imported into the US in 2026 face a 25 percent Section 232 tariff that took effect May 3, 2025. The tariff applies to engines, engine parts, transmissions, powertrain components, and electrical components for passenger vehicles and light trucks, regardless of country of origin. USMCA-qualifying parts from Canada and Mexico are exempt or partially exempt during a transition period.
